subject: Re: Status: estimation pipeline live, H spread across slices
body:
Wei, all — decisions ahead of the May 1 readout.

Tomas came through with fourteen model/eval pairs, and Rafael's analysis holds up: fractal parameters (H and J jointly) predict downstream eval averages better than BPB alone on our internal pairs, consistent with the paper's claim — modest sample, but directionally solid and worth acting on.

The readout will propose a Q3 pilot: corpus-quality scoring integrated into data-platforms' intake flow, scored on v2 once the migration lands. Scope discipline: we are not claiming fractal metrics replace evals, only that they improve pre-training data triage; I'll keep the language tight.

Amara, please make sure the v1-extracted slices are queued for the v2 re-validation pass per Daniela's plan. Readout deck to me by Apr 29.

Excellent quarter, team.

Priya
